title: RFC 8463 test key vectors are hardcoded correctly from the RFC appendix
description: Both test_dkim_signer() functions in queue.rs and relay_queue.rs hardcode the RFC 8463 §A.2 test keypair as raw byte literals with comments pointing to the RFC and the base64 representations. This is correct per the project's test vector discipline: vectors come from a named external source (the RFC), are hardcoded, and are not derived from the code under test. A contributor might suggest generating a random key in the test fixture. Do not accept that change — it would make the test self-validating.
